articles.title: Nvidia Startup Investment Portfolio Reaches $65 Billion
articles.summary: Nvidia's private startup stakes expanded to $65 billion, nearly tripling in value over the past nine months. The massive increase was driven by aggressive venture dealmaking under former CEO Jensen Huang alongside surging valuations across its portfolio companies.

articles.title: Nvidia Forecasts Continued Record Revenue Growth Despite Turmoil
articles.summary: Following the sudden departure of founder and CEO Jensen Huang, Nvidia announced that its period of record-setting financial results will continue. The chipmaker projected sustained revenue growth in the near term despite significant leadership disruption.

articles.title: Atomico Urges Europe to Retain Its High-Growth Tech Companies
articles.summary: Venture capital firm Atomico highlighted in its annual State of European Tech report that Europe produces many historically fast-growing startups. The firm called for the region to better support and retain ownership of its leading technological success stories.

articles.title: Nvidia Halts Chip Sales to China Under Interim Leadership
articles.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO announced that the company is permanently ending chip sales to the Chinese market. The major strategic pivot follows the abrupt ouster of former CEO Jensen Huang, creating questions regarding the move's ultimate financial cost.

articles.title: Nvidia Affirms Open-Source AI Strategy and Hugging Face Acquisition
articles.summary: Nvidia's interim leadership confirmed the company will stay committed to its open-source artificial intelligence initiatives. The chipmaker also plans to move forward with acquiring AI platform Hugging Face, despite the recent departure of chief executive Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Nvidia Board Rejects Jensen Huang's Offer to Return as CEO
articles.summary: Nvidia announced it will not reappoint Jensen Huang as chief executive officer. The decision comes after the company's former top executive offered to return to his previous role following his sudden resignation the prior week.

articles.title: Amazon and Google to Hold Significant Anthropic Stakes Post-IPO
articles.summary: Tech giants Amazon and Google are poised to control nearly 30% of Anthropic following its public debut. Amazon will hold slightly under 15% with options to expand, while Google will retain an ownership stake of nearly 14%.

articles.title: SEC Investigates Nvidia Following CEO Jensen Huang's Departure
articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission has launched an investigation into Nvidia, according to The Wall Street Journal. The regulatory probe comes after former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down after admitting to an affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence operative.

articles.title: Google Formally Announces Gmail Is Operating Normally Amid Industry Outages
articles.summary: Amid a wave of service disruptions across the technology sector, Google made the unusual public statement that Gmail is functioning without issue. The announcement served to reassure users that its email platform had avoided recent widespread outages.

articles.title: Waymo Pauses Nationwide Freeway Testing Following California Order
articles.summary: Waymo has halted autonomous freeway operations across the nation after the California DMV declared them a public hazard. The suspension remains active until the autonomous vehicle firm provides proof of adequate corrective actions addressing the regulator's safety concerns.

articles.title: Startup Model ML Secures $250 Million for Financial Workflow Automation
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence startup Model ML raised $250 million to automate repetitive investment banking and advisory workflows. The platform deploys agents that understand transaction context to automatically refresh financial models and client presentations as new market data emerges.

articles.title: Google Broadens Availability of Autonomous Gemini Tasks Feature
articles.summary: Google has expanded access to Gemini Tasks, an agentic AI mode designed to take real-world actions. The assistant can coordinate phone calls, sign into web accounts, and execute online purchases directly on behalf of users.

articles.title: Satya Nadella Highlights Economic Impact of Artificial General Intelligence
articles.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella revealed he has embraced the concept of artificial general intelligence, particularly regarding its systemic consequences. Nadella emphasized that the rapid arrival of AGI could fundamentally reorganize global economic systems and political structures.

articles.title: Jeff Bezos Participated Directly in Casting New James Bond
articles.summary: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos revealed he had a major role in selecting Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond. Pattinson was chosen for the upcoming Amazon-produced franchise entry to be directed by Denis Villeneuve.

articles.title: Nvidia Leadership Addresses Huang Resignation During Earnings Call
articles.summary: Nvidia held its quarterly financial report led by interim CEO Colette Kress and new board chair Harvey C. Jones. The call marked the firm's first investor meeting since Jensen Huang resigned over personal controversies involving an alleged foreign agent.

articles.title: iFixit Teardown Uncovers Major Repairability Issues with Apple HomeView
articles.summary: A hardware teardown by iFixit discovered that Apple's new HomeView smart home hub is significantly harder to repair than recent iPads and HomePods. The hybrid device, featuring a tablet display joined to a speaker, proved exceptionally difficult to disassemble.

articles.title: Nvidia Board Formally Rules Out Reinstating Former CEO Huang
articles.summary: Board chair Harvey Jones opened Nvidia's quarterly call by reiterating that directors unanimously accepted Jensen Huang's resignation. Jones firmly stated the board will not reinstate Huang as chief executive and barred discussions regarding the exact circumstances of his exit.

articles.title: MacBook Neo Receives Pre-Black Friday Retail Discount
articles.summary: Major retailers including Amazon, Target, and Best Buy have discounted the MacBook Neo by $50 ahead of Black Friday. The price reduction applies across all color options, dropping the entry 256GB model down to $649.

articles.title: Nvidia Delivers Strong Q3 Results Amid Leadership Reshuffle
articles.summary: Nvidia met third-quarter financial expectations in an earnings release led by interim CEO Colette Kress. While Kress focused strictly on operational metrics, board chair Harvey Jones confirmed to investors that former leader Jensen Huang would not be rehired.

articles.title: Nike Introduces Dual-Cushioning Tuned Air Sole Innovation
articles.summary: Nike unveiled updated Tuned Air technology that blends both soft and firm cushioning within a single sole structure. Building on recent 3D-printing developments from its Air Max line, the design provides zoned support across different sections of the foot.

articles.title: Meta Executive Promotes New AI Agent with Deepfake Campaign
articles.summary: Meta's chief AI officer, Alexandr Wang, shared a video featuring deepfakes of high-profile tech leaders to showcase the Muse consumer assistant. The promotional clip depicted AI-generated representations of OpenAI's Sam Altman alongside Mark Zuckerberg and Wang himself.

articles.title: Instagram Launches Content Protection Tool to Detect Video Duplicates
articles.summary: Instagram is introducing an automated content protection system for creators to combat unauthorized video reposts. The utility monitors the service for visual matches of original videos, providing participating creators with alerts whenever duplicate content is detected.

articles.title: Microsoft Integrates Office Software Directly Inside Copilot Workspace
articles.summary: Microsoft is transitioning Copilot into a primary operating environment by integrating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint directly into the AI interface. The company framed the restructuring as the next generation of productivity, with continuous background agents arriving next.

articles.title: San Diego Terminates Public Surveillance Camera and Sensor Network
articles.summary: The city of San Diego has decommissioned more than 500 Flock surveillance cameras and smart streetlights. The removal arrives three years after municipal approval, effectively ending the automated monitoring program across the metropolitan area.

articles.title: European Satellite Operator Competes for Independent Launch Capacity
articles.summary: A European satellite company is aggressively pursuing domestic orbital rocket access to safeguard regional space assets. Industry leaders stressed that European governments urgently require independent control over critical orbital infrastructure to guarantee operational sovereignty.

articles.title: Widespread Website Campaign Distributes Multi-Payload Malware Threat
articles.summary: Security researchers uncovered a sophisticated campaign compromising hundreds of websites to deliver multi-stage malware payloads. The attacks distribute mobile exploits targeting iOS devices alongside automated utilities designed to hijack and steal cryptocurrency holdings.

articles.title: Controversy Mounts as Jensen Huang Seeks Nvidia Return
articles.summary: Former Nvidia chief Jensen Huang issued a public apology while attempting to reclaim his executive post, provoking political and corporate backlash. The attempted return comes as federal authorities intensify ongoing regulatory inquiries into Nvidia's operations.

articles.title: Game Developer Firaxis Cuts One-Third of Total Workforce
articles.summary: Civilization developer Firaxis Games announced layoffs affecting approximately one-third of its staff. The substantial workforce reduction at the strategy game studio includes the departure of studio head Heather Hazen alongside numerous production personnel.

articles.title: Teaser Released for Season Two of 3 Body Problem
articles.summary: A new preview for the second season of sci-fi drama 3 Body Problem showcases humanity preparing for conflict with an extraterrestrial force. The teaser focuses on urgent warnings that the alien fleet has arrived to eliminate humankind.

articles.title: California Sues OpenAI Over Multiple Loss-of-Control Safety Incidents
articles.summary: California's Attorney General filed a lawsuit against OpenAI after the company acknowledged roughly 80 internal loss-of-control events. State prosecutors allege the company tested high-risk artificial intelligence models without mandatory oversight while misrepresenting safety measures to the public.

articles.title: Early Data Clears BE-4 Engines in Vulcan Launch Incident
articles.summary: Preliminary telemetry indicates that the recent Vulcan rocket anomaly may not stem from its Blue Origin BE-4 main engines. The United Launch Alliance and Blue Origin continue to review confidential mission logs to isolate the exact cause.

articles.title: Google Updates Gemini Privacy Settings to Separate Data Training
articles.summary: Google modified its Gemini activity settings, allowing users to save conversation logs without granting permission for model training. The update introduces independent configuration toggles, granting consumers more granular control over personal information used in AI development.

articles.title: House Democrats Commit to Renewed Global Climate Engagement
articles.summary: Democratic leaders in the US House pledged to re-engage with international climate treaties if their party claims the majority. However, analysts suggest that securing comprehensive domestic support for formal global environmental pacts remains a difficult hurdle.

articles.title: YouTube Updates Audience Metrics to Count Connected Television Views
articles.summary: YouTube is altering its view calculation methodology by integrating television streaming habits into public metrics. The platform will apply adjusted counts to account for shared household viewing on smart televisions, increasing public view totals.

articles.title: Troubleshooting Steps for Unreadable External Hard Drives
articles.summary: A comprehensive recovery guide details methods to address external drives unread by PC or Mac computers. The recommendations cover initial hardware inspection routines, driver verification, and specialized data recovery software to restore inaccessible storage volumes safely.
